about.hero_subtitle: A global multi-vendor marketplace connecting customers, vendors, and service providers.
about.mission_text: QOOQZ is built to empower businesses and individuals by providing a seamless, trusted, and AI-powered marketplace. We connect buyers with verified vendors and service providers across multiple industries — from physical products to jobs, auctions, and beyond.
about.vision_text: To be the leading multi-vendor platform in the MENA region and globally, enabling commerce without borders through technology, transparency, and trust.
about.value_trust_text: We build trust through verified vendors, secure payments, and transparent policies.
about.value_innovation_text: We leverage AI and cutting-edge technology to enhance every user experience.
about.value_community_text: We believe in empowering communities — vendors, buyers, and service providers alike.
about.value_security_text: Your data and transactions are protected by industry-standard security practices.
about.team_text: We are a diverse team of technologists, product designers, and business experts passionate about building the future of commerce.
about.join_text: Whether you are a customer looking for great deals or a vendor wanting to grow your business, QOOQZ is your platform.

privacy.intro: QOOQZ ('we', 'us', 'our') is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your data when you use the QOOQZ platform.
privacy.s1_account: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, password (hashed), and profile details you provide during registration.
privacy.s1_transaction: Transaction Data: Order history, payment records, wallet activity, and dispute information.
privacy.s1_usage: Usage Data: Pages visited, search queries, clicks, session duration, device type, browser, and IP address.
privacy.s1_communications: Communications: Messages you send via support tickets, contact forms, and chat features.
privacy.s1_cookies: Cookies and Tracking: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality, remember preferences, and analyze traffic.
privacy.s2_text: We use collected data to: provide and improve our services; process orders and payments; send transactional notifications (email, SMS, push); personalize your experience; detect and prevent fraud; comply with legal obligations; and operate AI-powered features such as smart search and document processing.
privacy.s3_text: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with: vendors/service providers you transact with (limited to fulfilling your order); payment processors and financial institutions; cloud infrastructure and analytics providers bound by confidentiality agreements; and legal authorities when required by law.
privacy.s4_text: We implement industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, hashed passwords, JWT-based authentication, access controls, and regular security audits. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure; however, we take all reasonable steps to protect your information.
privacy.s5_text: We use session cookies (essential for login and cart functionality) and analytics cookies (to understand usage patterns). You may disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect platform functionality.
privacy.s6_text: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as required to provide services and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy.s7_text: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; request correction or deletion; object to certain processing; and withdraw consent. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@qooqz.com.
privacy.s8_text: The platform integrates with third-party services (payment gateways, mapping, analytics, AI providers). These services have their own privacy policies and we are not responsible for their data practices.
privacy.s9_text: QOOQZ uses AI-powered features including smart search, chatbot assistance, and document processing. Data used to power these features is processed in accordance with this policy and is not used to train external AI models without your consent.
privacy.s10_text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or a prominent notice on the platform. Your continued use of the platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance.
privacy.s11_text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at privacy@qooqz.com.

terms.intro: These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your use of the QOOQZ platform. By accessing or using QOOQZ, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

terms.s2_text: You must provide accurate and complete information when registering. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials. QOOQZ reserves the right to suspend accounts that violate these Terms.
terms.s3_text: Users agree to: use the platform lawfully and in good faith; not post false, misleading, or fraudulent content; not engage in harassment, abuse, or harmful conduct; not attempt to bypass platform security measures; and comply with all applicable local and international laws.
terms.s4_text: Vendors are solely responsible for: the accuracy of product/service listings; fulfilling orders in a timely manner; providing legitimate customer support; holding all required business licenses and permits; and complying with consumer protection laws. QOOQZ acts as an intermediary and is not liable for vendor conduct.
terms.s5_text: QOOQZ operates on a commission-based model. Fees are deducted from vendor payouts as agreed during onboarding. Payments are processed through third-party payment gateways. QOOQZ does not hold user funds beyond transaction processing.
terms.s6_text: Customers may request refunds according to the vendor's stated return policy. Disputes should first be raised directly with the vendor. If unresolved within 7 days, users may escalate to QOOQZ support. QOOQZ will review disputes and may intervene in cases of fraud or policy violations. Our decision in dispute resolution is final.
terms.s7_text: All platform content, design, trademarks, and software are the property of QOOQZ or its licensors. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without express written permission.
terms.s8_text: The following are strictly prohibited: listing counterfeit or illegal products; money laundering or fraudulent transactions; scraping or automated data extraction; impersonating other users or entities; and any conduct that disrupts platform operations.
terms.s9_text: QOOQZ provides AI-powered features for convenience. These features are provided 'as-is' and may not always be accurate. AI-generated content should not be relied upon as professional legal, medical, or financial advice.
terms.s10_text: To the maximum extent permitted by law, QOOQZ is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid by you to QOOQZ in the 12 months preceding the claim.
terms.s11_text: QOOQZ may suspend or terminate your account at any time for violations of these Terms. You may also delete your account at any time via account settings or by contacting support.
terms.s12_text: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of UAE courts.
terms.s13_text: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
terms.s14_text: For questions about these Terms, contact us at legal@qooqz.com.

support.ticket_text: Submit a support ticket and our team will respond within 24 business hours.
support.faq_1_q: How do I track my order?
support.faq_1_a: Go to My Orders in your account, find your order, and click 'Track Order' to see real-time status.
support.faq_2_q: How do I request a refund?
support.faq_2_a: Submit a return request from My Orders within the vendor's return window. Our team will review and process it within 3–5 business days.
support.faq_3_q: How do I become a vendor?
support.faq_3_a: Click 'Join as Vendor' from the homepage or profile menu. Complete the verification process and start listing your products.
support.faq_4_a: Yes. All payments are processed through certified, PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways. We never store your full card details.
support.faq_5_q: How do I reset my password?
support.faq_5_a: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox.
support.contact_cta_text: Prefer to email or call? Reach our support team.
